stem: How are the authors’ purposes for including information about family in the article “A Country Connected” and the poem “The World Is at My Fingertips” DIFFERENT?

options.label: A
options.text: The author of the article emphasizes the importance of honoring family members from the past, but the poet emphasizes the casual nature of the speaker’s conversation with a family member.

options.label: B
options.text: The author of the article describes creative ways to show respect for family members, but the poet describes the speaker’s desire to make choices independently of other family members.

options.label: C
options.text: The author of the article emphasizes the significance of celebrating family achievements, but the poet emphasizes the speaker’s personal accomplishments.

options.label: D
options.text: The author of the article describes the need to maintain family traditions over time, but the poet describes the speaker’s hope to develop new traditions to pass down to future generations.
